claude.performance_metric: $2,336.6M merger goodwill tested May 1, 2021, not impaired; no divestiture, assets retained
claude.rationale: For p4: no product/process incoherence is documented — the combined utility operated as a single consolidated reporting unit with both legacy operating utilities continuing to exist under new subsidiary names, and net income and adjusted earnings both rose 2020→2021, so no realized product/operations disruption is documented (0). For p5: the slice shows a recurring "executive transition" cost line (inducement bonuses and severance: $10.5M in 2021, $7.6M in 2020), which is documented friction at the management/organization tier, but the filing does not attribute these costs to the merger integration and no detail on roles was located, so whether this reflects a realized process/organization fracture cannot be determined (uncertain). t1 and t2 have no supporting realized evidence in the slice, and goodwill was found not impaired.
